entries.headline: Configure planning with Studio and workspace settings
entries.summary: Studio lets you configure planning personas, templates, sections and generation presets, while workspace settings hold your profile, models, voice and brand. The completion wizard is back on session wrap-up to review and refine tasks.

highlights.text: Studio is where you configure planning personas, templates and presets
Workspace settings hold your profile, models, voice and brand
The completion wizard reviews and refines generated tasks on wrap-up

entries.headline: Solo becomes the center of the app
entries.summary: Agents and Solo merge into a single unified world. The app's interface simplifies by hiding world-switching menus when there's nothing to switch to, and your settings migrate automatically.

highlights.text: No more Agents world — Solo consolidates all capabilities
World-switching menus hide when there's only one option
Your previous arrangement and projects migrate automatically

entries.headline: Descriptions guide your project from the start
entries.summary: Your project description now shows in the workspace and seeds the first session, letting the AI reference your goals from the start. Attached screenshots and references reach the AI for more specific opening questions.

highlights.text: Your project description appears throughout the workspace, from composer to session
Screenshots and references attached to a project seed the first planning session
New projects show one action card instead of seven empty dashboard panels

entries.headline: Projects have a status and carry references
entries.summary: Give projects an explicit status so you can mark them done when finished, and keep them organized in separate In progress and Completed sections. Projects now carry descriptions with links to tickets, repos, pages, and screenshots.

highlights.text: Mark projects done when they're finished and reopen them if plans change
Add references to Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps and Confluence in the project
Attach screenshots to projects and see them with the description
New projects open automatically so you can start working right away

entries.headline: Agent security now tells you what to do
entries.summary: The security page opens with what needs a decision, replays the session behind each finding, and fixes it with a click or a pull request. Agent standup is gone and the agents pages stop re-scanning on every open.

highlights.text: Each finding says whether the command ran or was only written into a test file
Replay the transcript around a finding without leaving the page
Block a risky command family or fix a setting with one click, or open a PR
Cost pages count every token and say when a figure is included in your plan

entries.headline: Music now plays: radio, Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube
entries.summary: Browse and play music from the built-in radio, Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube Music. The player keeps playing when you leave the music page — pick a track, move to another page, and the pocket shows what's playing.

highlights.text: The built-in radio plays through six styles of visualizer
Sign in to Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube Music to browse your library
The player keeps playing when you leave the music page

entries.headline: Settings stays put as you move between sections
entries.summary: Every page now sits in the same column, so switching settings sections or moving between pages no longer shifts the layout sideways or leaves a stray scrollbar.

highlights.text: Themes and the theme editor line up with the other settings sections
Short pages no longer scroll, and long ones keep the same margins

entries.headline: A front page, a rail you arrange, and eight ducks
entries.summary: The home opens as a newspaper: one story at a time from yeaboi, AI and engineering, drawn in ink with a duck in the picture, from outlets you choose. The sidebar is a rail of squares you arrange, and the duck comes in eight personas.

highlights.text: The home is a front page: one story at a time, drawn in ink with a duck
Choose the front page's outlets in Settings, add your own feed, and set how fast it turns
The sidebar is a rail of squares: add any page, pick its icon or upload your own
Eight persona ducks: one stands in every front-page picture, in colour on the ink

entries.headline: The desktop app grows up: setup, updates, notes
entries.summary: A fresh install now opens a short setup wizard, and the app updates itself in one click. It also carries its own version and release notes, separate from yeaboi.

highlights.text: First run walks you through connecting a model, then voice, video and tools
Everything after the model is skippable — get going in under a minute
A new version downloads and installs in one click, then restarts for you
What's New keeps app changes and yeaboi changes apart, terminal notes aside
